gloss: mentioned above; as stated above; aforementioned

definitions.gloss: mentioned above; as stated above; the foregoing
definitions.explanation: Refers back to something that has been stated or described earlier in the same text, particularly in formal or academic writing.

examples.japanese: {上述|じょうじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
{上述|じょうじゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: For the reasons stated above, we will adopt this proposal.

examples.japanese: {上述|じょうじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}まえて→踏まえる：07701_fumaeru⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Based on the experimental results mentioned above, we will proceed to the next stage.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (above) + {述|じゅつ} (state, describe). Can be used as a noun ({上述|じょうじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ — the aforementioned) or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ({上述|じょうじゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ — stated above).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上述|じょうじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧ — as mentioned above
- {上述|じょうじゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ — stated above
- {上述|じょうじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧ — the aforementioned reasons
- {上述|じょうじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ — the problem mentioned above

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前記|ぜんき}→前記：22210_zenki⟧ — aforementioned (similar register; slightly less academic)
- ⟦{上記|じょうき}→上記：11375_jouki⟧ — above-mentioned (very common in documents and forms)
- ⟦{前述|ぜんじゅつ}→前述：11911_zenjutsu⟧ — previously stated (nearly synonymous; ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ emphasizes 'previous' over 'above')
- ⟦{下記|かき}→下記：11376_kaki⟧ — below-mentioned (the opposite direction)
- {後述|こうじゅつ} — described later (the opposite in sequence)

REGISTER:
Formal academic and legal writing. Especially common in research papers, theses, and official reports. Not used in conversation.
